linework.observation: Bold dark contours define bunk frames, storage lockers, the protagonist and the letters.

colour.observation: Muted navy and warm steel are mostly restrained, but the bright exterior red light and water view compete with the palette.

shading.observation: Soft illustrated shadows shape the berth and coveralls; no major photographic rendering.

character_construction.observation: The bald protagonist has readable face and proportions consistent with the identity sheet.

backgrounds.observation: Bunk room, lockers and narrow passage read as a submarine berthing space, but the large porthole implies an exterior view.

finish.observation: Cleanly rendered, though legible RETIREMENT lettering introduces an unintended prop detail.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist and navy coveralls match level one.

content.observation: FAIL: a large porthole looks out onto water, and a retirement folder appears in an entry-level bunk scene.

composition.observation: Wide-medium view keeps the figure in frame with enough room around the berth and desk.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist reading a letter with a tired expression.
regions.clothing: Navy coveralls consistent with a junior submariner.
regions.foreground_props: Letters, family photographs, mug and an unintended folder labeled RETIREMENT.
regions.architecture: Compact bunk and lockers; porthole and view outside are inaccurate for a submarine berth.
regions.distance: Narrow room depth shown through lockers and the bed frame.
regions.lighting: Warm overhead light is mixed with an impossible saturated red exterior glow.

correction: Keep the protagonist seated at the bunk reading a family letter in a cramped enclosed berthing compartment. Replace the porthole with a solid steel bulkhead and remove all legible retirement text or unrelated paperwork. Preserve character, costume, illustration style and framing.
